observed_evidence: Directory says it includes all CIBA Bookseller Members in good standing; information is based on what booksellers provide to CIBA; users can search by city/town, province/territory, specialty and more; page requires JavaScript for rendered results.
governance_use: Primary CIBA membership authority; do not rely on it for static row extraction in no-JS contexts.

observed_evidence: Bookseller Member eligibility covers privately held Canadian-owned independent bookstores, including traditional, pop-up, and mobile bookstores, with one to ten locations selling new books; secondhand and specialty stores are eligible if they sell some new books on an ongoing basis.
governance_use: Entity-role classification and promotion rules; preserve pop-up/mobile and secondhand/specialty caveats.

observed_evidence: IndieBookstores.ca was established in 2023 by CIBA; it helps readers search stores across Canada, find books in stock, use a map/directory, and redirects to store websites rather than operating as the online shop itself.
governance_use: Treat IndieBookstores as CIBA-owned consumer locator/availability overlay.
